name: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Ltd
about: Indian Metals and Ferro Alloys Limited (IMFA) is a leading, fully integrated producer of Ferro Chrome in India which is primarily used in the production of stainless steel. It was set up in 1961. [1]
keyPoints:
Business Segment
Co. has emerged as India’s largest fully integrated ferro chrome manufacturer[1] and leading producer of ferro chrome in India accounting for 20% of output and 25% of exports.[2]  Exports are primarily to China, Japan and Taiwan.[3]

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 21.4%
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 61.8 days to 40.8 days
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 9.73% over past five years.
